purpose: Construct hash-bound empirical XRXD action-type samples and a no-action control from the A-stock-accepted V4-00D package scope. This is diagnostic evidence and does not accept adjusted canonical output.

method.raw_record_format: TDX .day <IIIII f II, first uint32 is YYYYMMDD
method.independent_expected_value: separate Decimal transform: m=(10+C3+C4)/10; c=(C1-C4*C2)/10; compose only ex_day > bar_date through cutoff; ROUND_HALF_UP to CNY 0.01
method.unresolved_other_categories: Recorded per security; any potentially price-affecting unsupported category keeps adjusted quality UNAVAILABLE.

remaining_independent_gates: formal V4-00D source package overlap acceptance for scope and metadata identity
independent issuer/security identity and source visibility review
supported and unsupported category price-impact adjudication, including category 15
multi-cutoff determinism and future/late-revision leakage proof
per-security fail-closed quality receipt and independent audit closure
